tasks.title: Create model and deploy worker application
tasks.instructions:
Create a new model named `lab-scale` and deploy the `ubuntu` charm with application name `worker`:

```bash
juju add-model lab-scale
juju deploy ubuntu worker --channel latest/stable
```

Verify that `worker` appears in `juju status`:

```bash
juju status
```
hints: Create the model with `juju add-model lab-scale`.
Deploy the charm with `juju deploy ubuntu worker --channel latest/stable`.
tasks.solution:
```bash
juju add-model lab-scale
juju deploy ubuntu worker --channel latest/stable
```

tasks.title: Scale worker out
tasks.instructions:
Scale out the `worker` application horizontally by adding 2 additional units:

```bash
juju add-unit worker -n 2
```

Verify that multiple units are provisioning/running:

```bash
juju status worker
```
hints: Use `juju add-unit worker -n 2` to add 2 units.

tasks.title: Scale worker in
tasks.instructions:
Scale down the application by removing unit `worker/2` so that exactly 2 units remain active:

```bash
juju remove-unit worker/2
```

Verify that `worker/2` is removed and 2 units remain:

```bash
juju status worker
```
hints: Remove the unit with `juju remove-unit worker/2`.
